blocks.text: The Korea Agro-Fisheries & Food Trade Corporation (aT) ASEAN Regional Headquarters will host “Taste of Wonder, K-Food Manila 2026,” a promotional event for Korean agri-food products, on November 16 and 17 at the Glorietta Palm Drive Activity Center in Makati City, Metro Manila. Held in conjunction with the ASEAN Summit hosted by the Philippines, this two-day K-food festival invites visitors to taste and enjoy a wide variety of Korean dishes and fresh produce.
